adaptation: The pinned Zotero OpenAlex JSON translator remains the bibliographic mapping owner. Native Utilities.trimInternal/unescapeHTML/cleanAuthor and Item.itemToAPIJSON retain sanitation, schema mapping and creator types.
Narrow input normalization supplies display_name/year aliases, safe absent source/list defaults and scalar bibliographic strings; no title/publisher exceptions are added.

Ordinary unstructured OpenAlex display names retain native Zotero cleanAuthor parsing and personal-author citation behavior. Explicit structured names keep their supplied boundaries; explicit single-field/company markers and native one-part names use the native single-field representation. Creator OpenAlex/ORCID values remain alongside editable names, with complete provider records in import provenance.

Existing strict V3 abstract reconstruction/selection remains; malformed or oversized abstract text is unavailable with a recorded warning. OpenAlex metadata aliases use the shared strict work-identifier owner.

Both direct imports and enrichment use the native OpenAlex translator, then the existing SQLite exact-work-identity merge, scoped to the selected References database. Resolver queues, browser sessions, authorization and transports are unchanged.
